RO.Audit.Clean: No registered rule inconsistency was found.
RO.Audit.Help: Select exactly one owned token, or assign a user character. The audit checks managed-source consistency and invokes registered provider validators without changing the actor.

RO.Diagnostics.FullCopyHelp: Copies the complete diagnostics report, including descriptors, titles, UUIDs, and finding data. Review it carefully and only share it privately.
RO.Diagnostics.Help: Check provider modules, system compatibility, dependencies, compendia, source UUIDs, and pending migrations.
RO.Diagnostics.SharingHelp: Copies a minimal support summary: versions, counts, and finding codes without descriptors, names, UUIDs, or finding data. Preferred for public issue reports.
RO.Diagnostics.Title: Provider and world diagnostics
RO.Hub.Subtitle: A thin gateway for modular homebrew content, validation, provenance, and controlled migrations.

RO.Launcher.Summary: Inspect complementary homebrew modules, content provenance, character audits, and compatibility.
RO.Migrations.BackupWarning: Back up or clone the world before continuing. Migrations are never run automatically by the core.
RO.Migrations.ConfirmBody: Run all pending migrations in provider registration order. Provider code may update world documents according to its documented migration.
RO.Migrations.PendingBody: registered migration(s) have not been completed in this world.
RO.Naming.MetadataConflict: Provider and manifest naming metadata disagree. Provider expects “{expectedTitle}”; manifest expects “{manifestExpectedTitle}”.
RO.Naming.MetadataInvalid: The module manifest naming metadata is invalid: {reason}
RO.Naming.MetadataMissing: This legacy provider declares no Runyth Order naming metadata. It remains registered; add flags.runyth and provider naming metadata when the provider is next updated.
RO.Naming.ModuleMismatch: Module {moduleId} is titled “{actualModuleTitle}”; expected “{expectedTitle}”. Required pattern: {requiredPattern}.
RO.Naming.ProviderMismatch: Provider {providerId} is titled “{actualProviderTitle}”; expected “{expectedTitle}”. Required pattern: {requiredPattern}.

RO.Notifications.SupportCopied: Minimal support summary copied to the clipboard.
RO.Overview.BoundaryBody: The core registers and inspects complementary modules. It does not bundle campaign classes, silently change characters, replace the active game system, or execute unregistered remote code.
RO.Packs.Empty: No content packs have registered yet.
RO.Packs.Help: Packs remain owned by their provider modules; the core stores only validated descriptors and source references.
